story_sequence.text: Cutover preflight detects legacy or mixed truth state, including old `prd/`, `user-story/`, `qa/test-cases/` surfaces, missing feature package files, missing governance MD, missing projection, and stale agent-surface guidance.
`beacon-change-refreeze` must detect legacy/mixed state before refreeze and route to cutover instead of presenting `beacon change ... --refreeze-chain` as sufficient.

Beacon exposes a human-facing one-command cutover wrapper that runs or reports phases: inventory, package materialize/validate, truth-map verify, governance verify/projection, agent-surface refresh, and resume.
Requirement package cutover must validate `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` as v1.5.2 package authority; legacy triptych can be absorb/rebuild/archive-only and cannot win authority.
Project governance cutover must verify `docs/beacon/governance/project-version-governance.md` and generated sqlite/runtime projection, failing closed on missing version contract or projection drift.
Cutover must detect stale installed/project skills or agent rules that still present old triptych as normal v1.5.2 truth authority and route to `doctor setup-agent-surface` / verify.
Freeze, refreeze, implement, QA, and release must fail closed while package authority, governance MD, or agent-surface verification is incomplete or contradictory.
After successful cutover, Beacon resumes the original operator intent, such as refreeze, without requiring the operator to rediscover the next command.

For v1.5.2 package-authoritative features, `beacon implement plan` must consume `features/<slug>/tasks.md` as the requirement-owned task intent and may return a draft/skeleton plan even when execution admission is blocked; implementation progress must write to execution/progress artifacts, not mutate `tasks.md` checkbox state.

Beacon must close the four accepted friction findings with the lowest-cognitive-load route: keep `truth-cutover` as a CLI/machine repair transaction instead of adding a new default public skill, route existing human surfaces to it, add explicit `doctor truth-source-mismatch` diagnostics and repair commands, and regression-test the `technical_review_contract` root fix plus change CLI version stability.

artifact_read_model.summary: machine completeness projection is missing, but v1.5.2 package truth and coverage are valid authority

decision_traceability.summary: human requirement truth is carried by the authoritative feature package

downgrade_control.summary: legacy completeness projection absence does not downgrade package authority
